lines.en: I fly lightly above the grass blades.
The light on my wings is prismatic.

lines.zh: 我从这朵花飞向下一朵。
lines.en: I drift from this flower to the next.
I don't fly high or far.
A breeze comes and I drift.
I land on a leaf tip.
The night here is quiet.
I fan my wings slowly.
I go from this clump of grass to that.
I settle, then rise again.
My shadow flickers on the grass.

lines.zh: 我绕着你的头顶飞了半圈。
lines.en: I circled half way around your head.
I rest in a flower's heart.

lines.zh: 翅膀合着，只露出一点光。
lines.en: Wings folded, only a trace of light shows.
I'm tiny and hard to see.
I listen to the wind.
The petals are soft.
I slowly tuck my feet in.
This little light is enough for me.
I sway along with the wind.
There's no one in the night.
I'm waiting for the dew.
The grass stirs softly.
A little longer.
My light falls on the petals.
A dewdrop sits on the grass.
I rest in the flower without moving.
Insects call somewhere far off.
A drop of dew hangs on the leaf tip.
I tuck my antennae under my wings.
Did your eyes find me?
I'm this small and I glow.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸吹乱了我的光。
lines.en: Your breath blurs my light.
I go around to the flower's other side.
Your hand is too close.
I flew a little higher.
Move, and my light scatters.
When you come near, my wings tremble.
Your steps bent the grass.
I fly to a farther flower.
You can see my light.
I'm a little curious too.
A small tear in my wing.
I fell off the flower.
It hurts. I can't fly steady.
Don't swat at me.

lines.zh: 七彩的翅膀，一碰就掉粉。
lines.en: One touch and my rainbow wings shed dust.
I squeeze into the gap between the petals.
Even a little wound is serious.
Colored dust falls all over the ground.
I still want to fly.
Don't touch again.
Is that flower still open?
Prismatic wings, a little sweetness on them.
What you hold is only a grass stem.
Hold the flower lower.
That's not the scent I know.
I circled half way before daring to approach.
The flower in your hand is moving.
It's brighter than a wild one.
That smell isn't nectar.
Don't squeeze it.
Your finger brushed my wingtip.
I flipped over.
A little light fell off my wing.
Don't swat with your hand.
My wing bends a rainbow of light.
I'm flying again.
Your bump knocked petals loose.

lines.zh: 我被你的袖子扇得翻了圈。
lines.en: Your sleeve swats me into a flip.
The wind pushed me a bit away.
Your scent stayed on my wings.
There's another on that flower.
We fan our wings at each other.
Our lights blend.
Don't clap at me.
We circle the flower.

lines.zh: 夜里只有我们两个在发光。
lines.en: Only the two of us glow in the night.
We won't stay long.
We'll scatter before dawn.
Don't block our light.
We're very light.
I can't carry it.
My feet are too small.
Let me look at that fallen petal.
It's bigger than my wing.

lines.zh: 花瓣被我压得弯了一下。
lines.en: The petal bends a little under my weight.
I grip it with all six legs.
It has dew on it.
This thing weighs more than I do.
My wings change color in the light.
I rest my wings here a moment.
Is that flower glowing?
No, I misjudged.

lines.zh: 草叶上有个影子压下来。
lines.en: A shadow drops onto the leaves.
I perch on a grass tip and size things up first.
I circle halfway around and dare not land.
It's much bigger than me.
I'll circle wide.
It's safer here.
I land on a leaf.
I'll stay still.
The grass sounded again.
Wings folded to give a smaller target.
I watch from just above the grass.
It hasn't moved.
I move just a little nearer.
The wind moved it.
It's a leaf.
I got worked up for nothing.
I circle back.
The flower over there is still open.
I lower my feet.
I'll land right here.
Prismatic wings flickered once.
There really is something there.

lines.zh: 我拿翅缘碰了碰你的指节。
lines.en: I bump your knuckle with my wing edge.
I'm too small.

lines.zh: 这点力气，什么也推不动。
lines.en: This much force moves nothing.
I stirred my wings.
That's only wind.
I circle to the flower's back.
My glow flashed at you.
You didn't even move.
I'll just go.
Sorry.
I rise up out of the grass.
My wings are full of colored light.
This meadow is utterly quiet.
I peek out from the base of the flower.

lines.zh: 夜里只有我一个人亮着。
lines.en: Tonight I'm the only thing glowing.
Prismatic wings, only at night.

lines.zh: 一片叶子接住了我的光。
lines.en: A leaf catches my light.
My feet got wet.
Can you see this little light?
A speck of color rises from the grass.
I fly around the grass blade.
My wings settle first.

lines.zh: 火一靠近，我的光就缩起来了。
lines.en: The fire neared and my light shrank.

lines.zh: 从花上掉下来，草接住了我。
lines.en: I fell from the flower and the grass caught me.

lines.zh: 露水粘住翅膀，我飞不动。
lines.en: Dew gums my wings; I can't fly.

lines.zh: 气浪把我吹出去了很远。
lines.en: The blast carried me far.
A thin thorn pierced me through.

lines.zh: 一道光包住我，我动不了。
lines.en: Light wrapped around me and I couldn't move.

lines.zh: 没有花蜜，我的光越来越弱。
lines.en: Without nectar, my light grows weaker.
Lightning turned the meadow white.

lines.zh: 没有花，我的光也没用了。
lines.en: No flowers here; even my light is useless.
